verdict.rationale: BVNK's docs say wallets can be created and managed 'through the Portal or API' and that payment capabilities are reachable via 'the BVNK portal or API'. Many core operations (rules, simulations, transfers, payouts) are documented as API endpoints. However, nothing states full API/UI parity, and API key generation is documented only as a Portal step. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement covering all Portal features, API-based key and credential management, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no feature is Portal-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: On BVNK, you can create and manage both crypto and fiat wallets through the Portal or API.
access payment capabilities through the BVNK portal or API for your own use
To create a rule that links a fiat virtual account to a crypto blockchain address, send the [`POST /payment/v1/rules`]
